names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 23 mai, «Sfântul Ierarh Mihail Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Sinadei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Μιχαήλ επίσκοπος Συνάδων ο Ομολογητής», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 23. мај ст. ст., „Свети Михаил епископ синадски“ — Свети is not a rank, епископ is the `bishop` this corpus puts in `types` and the `Bishop` it puts in `office`, and „синадски“ is the see, which `honorific.js` composes and the display name already carries. Strip all three and the fullest form this calendar gives is the bare personal name. **THIS IS A DELIBERATE FOLD AND IT WAS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED.** `foldchk.py` returns eleven folders already holding a bare «Михаил» — `michael-of-chernigov`, `michael-of-klops` and `michael-of-ulumbo` on `sr` forms and eight twentieth-century Russian confessors on `ru` ones — so storing it here makes a twelfth, exactly as the bare «Стефан» took a twelfth holder on 17 May and the «Силуан» fold was entered on purpose on 15 May. **There is no fuller form to prefer**: the heading prints nothing between the name and the see, and a see is not part of the stored form. `corpus-gate.mjs` will print the fold as a `?` row and it is the right answer.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Μιχαήλ επίσκοπος Συνάδων ο Ομολογητής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same man: bishop of Synada, confessor under Leo the Armenian for the sake of the icons, and companion of Theophylact of Nicomedia. Its head line reads «Οσιος Μιχαηλ Επισκοπος Συναδων ο Ομολογητης (; - 821)», a death year the folder's existing dates may now be read against; nothing in `dates` is touched by this upgrade. The page names [Theophylact](/saints/theophylact-of-nicomedia), whom it sends to 8 Μαρτίου, and the Patriarch [Tarasius](/saints/tarasius-of-constantinople), who founded the monastery on the Euxine where the two were tonsured and who ordained them presbyters; both are in the corpus on the days the page gives them, so both get a `related` row.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 05.06.2026 (23. мај ст. ст.) — „Свети Михаил епископ синадски“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, on the same menologion 23/5 the Romanian and Greek rows already carry. **The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop**: all three headings on this day end bare, where the 22 May and 3 March headings quoted on other folders in this wave carry one. The string is the `<strong>` element whole and nothing was added to it. **A FIRST DATE, AND IT IS THE ONE THING TWO CALENDARS COULD NOT GIVE HIM.** doxologia’s life closes „The page gives no year for his birth or his death“ and saint.gr gives none either, so this folder has stood undated. The Prologue states one outright — „и 818. године пресели се у царство Христа Цара“ — and it is his own death, stated as a year and not derived from a reign, a lifespan or a duration, so `dates.death` is written 818 to 818, `basis: "traditional"`, with the book’s own words in the `note`. **Nothing was narrowed and nothing was widened**: there was no interval here to narrow. **No `birth`**, the book giving none. **`types` UNTOUCHED, AND DELIBERATELY.** „Због свог подвижничког и девственог живота“ — for his ascetic and virginal life — would map to `ascetic` and `virgin` by BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5, **but both words are adjectives on his manner of life in the body and neither is a rank in the heading**, which prints only „епископ“; the folder already holds `hierarch`, `bishop` and `confessor`, all three corroborated here. Both are in the prose instead. `office` untouched at `Bishop`, the heading’s „синадски“ saying no more than the stored `Bishop` plus the display name already say. **TWO THINGS NO PAGE READ FOR HIM BEFORE SAYS, AND ONE FLAT DISAGREEMENT.** New: that **he took part in the Seventh Ecumenical Council** — „Участвовао на VII васељенском сабору“, which the doxologia life mentions only as the council whose anathema the heresy broke, never as something he attended; and that **at the emperor’s wish he went to the caliph Harun al-Rashid to negotiate peace**. The disagreement is the wonder. doxologia has the two friends at harvest time, in heat and without water, making a dry copper vessel pour out water; **the Prologue has them in a time of drought bringing abundant rain down on the earth by their prayers** — „у сушно време, ова два светитеља својим молитвама низведоше обилан дажд на земљу“. Thirst answered from a vessel and a drought answered from the sky are not the same wonder told twice, and **both are recorded and neither is resolved**, which is what this corpus does with a disagreement between two books. The Prologue also confirms what both other books say and adds nothing to: the companionship with Theophylact, the consecration by Tarasius, the deposition under Leo the Armenian for the icons, and the death in exile in want. **A COUNCIL IS NOT A FOLDER AND A CALIPH HAS NONE.** The Seventh Ecumenical Council is not a person; `harun-al-rashid` is nobody the corpus keeps and `ls saints | grep -i harun` returns nothing, so by the coordinator’s third ruling nothing is minted for him and he stands in the prose unlinked. **No new `related` rows**: Theophylact and Tarasius are the only people in the entry who have folders and both are already in this folder’s `related`, in both directions. No `locations`, although Synada and the Euxine are named elsewhere on the folder. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Îndreptător credinţei şi chip blândeţilor, învăţător înfrânării te-a arătat pe tine turmei tale adevărul lucrurilor. Pentru aceasta ai câştigat cu smerenia cele înalte, cu sărăcia cele bogate. Părinte Ierarhe Mihail, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Mihail Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Sinadei», Glasul 4

english.text: A rule of faith and a model of meekness, a teacher of abstinence — so has the truth of things shown you to your flock. Therefore you gained the heights by humility and riches by poverty. Father and hierarch Michael, entreat Christ our God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Θεῷ ἀναθεμένος, τὴν σὴν ζωὴν ἐκ παιδός, ποιμὴν ἀνηγόρευσαι, καὶ Ἱεράρχης σεπτός, Χριστοῦ ἱερώτατε· ὅθεν τὴν τοῦ Δεσπότου, ὡς τιμήσας Εἰκόνα, θλίψεις ἐν ἐξορίαις, Μιχαὴλ καθυπέστης· καὶ νῦν ἀναπηγάζεις ἡμῖν, ῥεῖθρα ἰάσεων.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of «Όσιος Μιχαήλ επίσκοπος Συνάδων ο Ομολογητής»

english.text: Having dedicated thy life to God from childhood, thou wast proclaimed a shepherd and a revered hierarch, most holy one of Christ; and so, for honouring the image of the Master, O Michael, thou didst endure afflictions in exile, and now thou pourest out for us streams of healings.

hymns.text: Ὥσπερ μέγας ἤλιος, ἐξανατείλας, καταυγάζεις ἅπαντας, τῶν ἀρετῶν σου τῷ φωτί, καὶ τῶν θαυμάτων ταῖς λάμψεσι, θαυματοφόρε, Ἀγγέλων ὁμώνυμε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of «Όσιος Μιχαήλ επίσκοπος Συνάδων ο Ομολογητής»

english.text: Risen like a great sun, thou dost light all men with the light of thy virtues and with the flashing of thy wonders, O bearer of wonders, thou who sharest the name of the angels.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 05.06.2026 (23. мај ст. ст.): „и 818. године пресели се у царство Христа Цара“. The first year any calendar read for this folder states; doxologia and saint.gr both give none.
